description: This file defines a Spring service class 'CreateMeetingCommandHandler' that handles commands for creating meetings. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and uses 'MeetingWritePlatformService' to process the creation logic upon receiving a command.

classes.name: CreateMeetingCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles 'CREATE' commands for meetings, utilizing the MeetingWritePlatformService to create new meetings.

methods.name: CreateMeetingCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the MeetingWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to create a new meeting by delegating to the MeetingWritePlatformService.
